events.t: Live WTA Finals: Gauff v Noskova
events.sy: With a path to the semi-finals clearly mapped out for both, opening-day winners Coco Gauff and Linda Noskova face off. Noskova claimed victory in the sole meeting of the two this year.
Former finalists Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend face Ellen Perez and Demi Schuurs. Italians Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini play Cristina Bucsa and Nicole Melichar-Martinez.
